title: Annotatio II §.VIII close: Bayer wastes oil proving Luther ≠ Cambrai; stop before §.IX Marburg
pass_a_gloss: Whence Bayer cannot but lose oil and labor, having strained to show that Luther fostered both an opinion diverse from the Cambrai [cardinal’s] and, besides Cambrai’s, one common to many — Disputation on Impanation no. 50.
pass_b_english: So Bayer wastes oil and labor trying to prove Luther both differed from Cambrai and shared a wider common opinion (Disput. de Impan. §50).
Stop before §.IX (Marburg determination; difficulties of corporal-in-bread presence).
source_text: Unde non potest non oleum & operam perdere Bajerus, in id annisus, ut ostendat, Lutherum & diversam à Cameracensi opinionem, & præter Cameracensem, pluribus communem, fovisse, Disput. de Impan. num. 50.
